question: What single cause uplifts the play of threefold sovereignty within the supreme atom and māyā?
premises: This play shines within the supreme atom and māyā.
Such uplifting requires a sole cause.
inference: The addressed lord alone is the cause that uplifts and manifests the play of sovereignty within limitation.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of traiśvarya in this context is not fully explicit.
plain_english: O sole cause of the uplifting play of threefold sovereignty, shining in sport within the supreme atom and māyā.
